question_pt: Qual e a taxa de mortalidade hospitalar por sexo?
sql: SELECT s.DESCRICAO AS sexo, COUNT(*) AS internacoes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.MORTE) AS mortes, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.MORTE) / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_morte_pct FROM internacoes i JOIN sexo s ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY taxa_morte_pct DESC
